Name: Masquerade
Principle1Roleplay: It is vitally important that you hide your true identity. You have a career that allows you to slip between identities when necessary.
Principle1MinorTwist: What clue about your real identity did you leave behind?
Principle1MajorTwist: Who from your civilian life is now in imminent danger?
Principle2Roleplay: You value your own safety more than most others in your line of work. You will never be caught fully unaware in a situation where your life is at stake.
Principle2MinorTwist: Who suffers because of your hesitation?
Principle2MajorTwist: Are you willing to lay down your life to save others?

Name: Titus Andromeda
Principle1Roleplay: You are governed by a strict code of conduct. Even under coercion, you will not compromise your ideals.
Principle1MinorTwist: Your honor has been challenged. How will you answer?
Principle1MajorTwist: Will you choose your honor, or your life?
Principle2Roleplay: You are very strong, so you must be careful to not crush delicate things. You do not need to roll to perform mundane acts of great strength.

Name: Pink Panther
Principle1Roleplay: You have a variety of contacts from the criminal underworld and organized crime.
Principle1MinorTwist: What shady detail causes others to distrust you?
Principle1MajorTwist: Are you guilty of what you're being arrested for?
Principle2Roleplay: You are just a normal person who has had power thrust upon them or are otherwise in over your head. You don't have the same sense of lofty purpose as other heroes. When needed, you can make yourself just another face in the crowd.
Principle2MinorTwist: Which hero did you make look good at the expense of yourself?
Principle2MajorTwist: How are you utterly and totally out of your league?

Name: Handyman
Principle1Roleplay: You have two (or more) entirely separate facets to your personality. As a result you can look at a situation from many different angles.
Principle1MinorTwist: What perspective ended up being the wrong one for the situation?
Principle1MajorTwist: What inner conflict has completely thrown you off?
Principle2Roleplay: It is vitally important that you hide your true identity. You have a career that allows you to slip between identities when necessary.
Principle2MinorTwist: What clue about your real identity did you leave behind?
Principle2MajorTwist: Who from your civilian life is now in imminent danger?
